text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-o-n-f-i-g-u-r-e-d a-s-s-i-g-n-a-l e-m-i-t-t-e-r t-o b-l-o-c-k g-n-s s-a-t-e-l-l-i-t-e f-i-x e-s a-n-d d-e-r-o-u-t-e d-d-r-o-n-e-s, l-e-f-t-t-h-e b-e-a-c-o-n d-e-v-i-c-e a-t t-h-e d-r-o-p z-o-n-e, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y s-i-g-n-a-l i-n-t-e-r-f-e-r-e-n-c-e r-e-p-o-r-t i-n g.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r i-n-t-e-r-c-e-p-t-e-d p-a-r-c-e-l s d-r-o-p-p-e-d a-t t-h-e f-a-l-s-e l-a-n-d-i-n-g p-o-i-n-t, l-e-f-t-t-h-e c-o-l-l-e-c-t-e-d p-a-r-c-e-l s a-n-d t-a-p-e r-e-s-i-d-u-e s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y i-n-t-e-r-c-e-p-t i-n-c-i-d-e n-o-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r l-o-g-g-e-d f-a-l-s-e d-i-a-g-n-o-s-t-i-c r-e-c-o-r-d s i-m-i-t-a-t-i-n-g n-o-r-m-a-l e-n-v-i-r-o-n-m-e-n-t a-l b-l-u-n-t, l-e-f-t-t-h-e t-a-m-p-e-r-t-u-r-e d-i-s-c-r-e-p-a-n-c-y i-n d-e-v-i-c-e m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y g-e-o-l-o-c-a-t-i-o n a u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l c-o-r-r-e-l-a-t-i-o-n.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-l-e-a-r-e-d d-e-v-i-c-e l-o-g-s a-f-t-e-r e-a-c-h i-n-t-e-r-f-e-r-e n-c-e w-i-n-d-o-w, l-e-f-t-t-h-e d-e-c-r-y-p-t-e-d c-o-n-f-i-g u-r-a-t-i-o n b-a-c-k-u-p s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y l-o-g i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y h-a-s-h v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r m-o-v-e-d t-h-e h-a-r-d-w-a-r-e t-o a s-h-r-a-g s-c-o-t-e l o-c-a-t-i-o-n a-f-t-e-r t-h-e i-n-c-i-d-e n-w-i-n-d-o-w, l-e-f-t-t-h-e s-p-o-o-f-i-n-g a-n-t-e-n-n-a a-s a n o-m-a-d-i c t-r-a-n-s-m-i-t-t-e-r, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y d-e-v-i-c-e d-i-s-p-o-s-a-t-i-o n r-e-g-i-s-t-r-a-t-i-o-n.
